protocol.reference_initialization: piecewise-constant prolongation of the exact same 64-cell initial averages; no hidden subcell initial information
protocol.fno_scope: compact matched periodic residual FNO; architecture baseline, not an exact reproduction of published FNO experiments
protocol.learned_flux_scope: matched conservative four-cell unconstrained learned-flux baseline; family comparison, not an exact reproduction of one published neural-FV architecture
